route: C: permutation-invariant variable-camera observation/geometry-only warm initializer for three-dimensional BOST reconstruction
headline: v188 independently shows that preserving DCT12 coefficients separately for every camera removes a major all-nine pooling penalty but still fails both sensor arms. Five-camera K1 remains 2/52 strict-safe and all-nine remains 0/52, with 0/4 complete time strata in both arms.
headline_zh: v188 经独立复算确认：逐相机保留 DCT12 消除了九相机的一大池化惩罚，但两档相机仍未通过。五相机 K1 仍为 2/52，九相机仍为 0/52，两臂完整时间层均为 0/4。
next_scientific_gate: Do not retune or enlarge either closed DCT12 representation. A physically distinct, separately preregistered dense per-camera detector-potential reference may test whether the remaining loss is specifically DCT12 truncation or a deeper affine-inverse limitation. It remains a post-open capacity diagnostic. No neural training, GPU rental, resource gate, untouched test, or real-BOST claim is authorized.
next_scientific_gate_en: Do not retune or enlarge either closed pooled or camera-resolved DCT12 representation. A physically distinct, separately preregistered dense per-camera detector-potential reference may test whether the remaining loss is specifically DCT12 truncation or a deeper affine-inverse limitation. It remains a post-open capacity diagnostic. No neural training, GPU rental, resource gate, untouched test, or real-BOST claim is authorized.
next_scientific_gate_zh: 不重调、不扩大已关闭的 pooled 或 camera-resolved DCT12 表示。下一门只可另行结果前冻结物理上真正不同的稠密逐相机 detector-potential 参考，检验剩余损失究竟来自 DCT12 截断还是更深的仿射逆限制；它仍只是已开封容量诊断。当前不授权神经训练、GPU、资源门、封存 test 或真实 BOST 主张。
